about_the_game:
A dungeon crawler where luck is your only weapon.

Every action, every event, every discovery is determined by... a slot machine. Dive into a procedurally generated dungeon, explore its mysterious depths, and let fate pull the strings of your adventure.

Attack, defend, loot, trade, or flee — it all depends on the spin.

An unpredictable dungeon crawler

Every action is handled through a one-armed bandit.

It's not just luck — try to stop the reels at the right moment to trigger favorable outcomes.

Combine symbols to unleash powerful effects… or devastating disasters.

Adapt your strategy based on the spins and the artifacts you unlock along the way.

Spend energy to re-spin certain reels and try to improve your results.

What to expect?

  • Procedurally generated maps — no dungeon is ever the same

  • Varied weapons, powerful items, and incredible artifacts

  • Multiple playable classes, each with their own unique twists

  • Goblins, skeletons, bandits, ghosts, dragons… and much worse

  • Mysterious chests, shops, unexpected blessings or curses

  • Modify probabilities, rig your luck… or suffer the consequences

  • Permadeath — every run is a unique attempt to go deeper than ever before

In Pereelous, luck is your weapon.
Will you twist fate to your advantage… or become its eternal plaything?
